description: Java Spring MVC controller class handling admin user group management, including displaying group info, listing groups with pagination, and setting UI menus.

classes.name: GroupsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing admin user groups, including listing, editing, and configuring group info with security annotations.

methods.name: displayGroup
methods.description: Handles GET request to display a specific group's details for editing, identified by group ID.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET request to display a list of groups.

methods.name: pageGroups
methods.description: Handles POST request to fetch and paginate group data in JSON format for AJAX responses.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context and attributes for admin UI pages.
